title: The Big Pie
note: b383 — first use of 'pie' (plain and cut) and 'bow_tie'. Purple mouths from the plum filling are not drawn (no mouth/stain geometry in the kit) — the joyful closed-eye expression plus proximity to the pie carries the joke instead, per the brief's own priority of matching the text over every literal brief detail.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar beside a pie easily four times his size, standing on his back legs to see over the crust. Comic scale.
pages.alt: Fig stands beside a pie easily four times his own size, up on his back legs to see over the crust.

pages.brief: The pie cut open to show deep purple plum filling, glossy and rich, steam rising. Make it genuinely mouth-watering.
pages.alt: The pie is cut open to show deep purple plum filling, glossy and rich, with steam rising from it.

pages.brief: Nell hovering over the pie taking a small neat bite from the very edge, being polite about it. Fig watching.
pages.alt: Nell hovers over the pie, taking a small, polite bite from the very edge, while Fig watches.

pages.brief: Both of them mid-mouthful, faces smeared purple, eyes shut in bliss. Close-cropped and joyful.
pages.alt: Fig and Nell are both mid-mouthful, eyes shut in complete bliss over the pie.

pages.brief: Fig lying flat on his back beside the mostly-eaten pie with an enormously round middle, all legs in the air. Very funny.
pages.alt: Fig lies curled up and resting beside the mostly-eaten pie, his middle enormously round.

pages.brief: Nell carefully arranging a tiny bow tie made of ribbon around Fig's neck while he lies there, too full to object.
pages.alt: Nell carefully arranges a tiny ribbon bow tie around Fig's neck while he lies there, far too full to object.

pages.brief: Fig standing up wearing the tie, striking a dignified pose, still purple-mouthed. Nell applauding with all six legs.
pages.alt: Fig stands up wearing his new bow tie, striking a dignified pose, while Nell applauds.

pages.brief: Closing page: the empty pie dish, the two of them asleep in it like a bed, tie still on Fig. Golden evening light.
pages.alt: Closing page: Fig and Nell lie asleep together in the empty pie dish like a bed, Fig's bow tie still on, in golden evening light.
